title: Atlassian: access-aware collaboration
summary: Keep draft content, comment audience, actual access and presence distinct through rejection and recovery.
use_when: People discuss a shared document while draft state, comment visibility and permission changes must remain explicit.
avoid_when: Presence or a mention is being used as authorization, or the product needs a real access-control implementation rather than a local teaching flow.
